description: Creating a space mission planning game.
summary: A game where you manage a space station and alongside its resources such as energy and mined regolith
details:
The project, also known as Project Station is a game about being in a moon base and resource management, mainly the management of energy. Said energy is used for various purposes said as managing mining drills to fulfilling a quota and life support systems.

Mainly aimed at younger audience, the game intends to teach the children about what goes on during the space mission, with the focus point being the intricacies of completing the mission (spending energy to power drills and mining regoliths to fulfill the quota) or for better chances of surviving the mission (using energy to power life support). By doing so, we hope children would learn the logistics and decision makings that happens in a moon base.

Various softwares are used as tools for the development such as Aseprite for making overall art assets and UI, Godot for overall game engine and scripting (GDscript).

Our team strives for creativity by taking an unusual route in the convention of gameplay, and creating assortment of original and human-made assets for the game.

Many factors are considered and researched properly, such as the prerequisites of keeping a space station standing and the various things necessary for keeping astronauts surviving in harsh environment such as the moon, proper research of game variables such as power consumption of the drills to make the game feel most scientifically accurate as possible.
